market_outlook.short_term: Markets face a tug-of-war: Fed rate hike (likely next week) and bond volatility vs. oil pullback and equity resilience. CPI stickiness keeps inflation fears alive. Middle East escalation is the primary wildcard. Expect elevated VIX, choppy equities, and continued bond selling. Oil likely $95-105 range. BTC tests $75K support.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex supercycle continues but debt-funding raises sustainability questions. Energy transition (nuclear, grid) is a multi-year theme. Consumer inflation may moderate if oil stabilizes, but structural cost pressures (housing, food) persist. Fed likely at higher-for-longer regime. Geopolitical fragmentation (trade wars, sanctions) adds permanent risk premium.
